Prolean Wellness Affiliate Program

• About our brand and products:

Founded in 2011, Prolean Wellness is a physician-led medical weight loss and body sculpting company based in Scottsdale, Arizona. We specialize in science-backed, medical-grade wellness programs and premium supplements designed for sustainable transformation. Our product line features highly specialized "Stacks," such as the Cellular Energy Stack, which uses advanced nutrient blends to optimize mitochondrial function and metabolic health.

• What makes us different:

Unlike "fad diets" or generic supplement shops, we are rooted in data and clinical science. We prioritize real food and sustainable lifestyle changes over liquid diets and extreme restrictions. Our brand is trusted because we don't guess—we measure. From metabolic testing to personalized nutrition strategies, our products are engineered to provide "medical-grade" results that customers can see and feel, making them highly referable.

• How affiliates can earn:

As a Prolean Wellness affiliate, you earn a competitive commission on every sale you refer.

Generous Commissions: Earn 15% commission on our high-margin wellness stacks and premium supplements.

Recurring Income: With our Appstle-integrated subscription model, you can earn recurring commissions on every subsequent order for customers who sign up for a monthly wellness routine for upto the lifetime of the customer or 366 days whichever is earlier.

The affiliate program incentivizes repeat purchases through a Wellness Rewards program that earns customers 10 points for every $1 spent, along with recurring revenue opportunities via an Appstle-integrated subscription model. See more at https://proleanwellness.com/rewards

High Average Order Value (AOV): Our specialized stacks (like the Cellular Energy Stack) are designed to solve complete problems, leading to larger carts and higher payouts for you.

• How to promote us:

We provide the tools you need to succeed with your audience:

Direct-to-Stack Links: Send your followers directly to our high-converting stack pages to maximize conversion rates.

Exclusive Coupons: Request unique, non-stackable discount codes to share on social media (Instagram, TikTok) or your blog.

Target Audience: Promote us to health-conscious individuals, busy professionals seeking energy, and anyone tired of "quick fix" diets who wants a science-based approach to metabolic health.

• Other information:

Industry-Leading 60-Day Cookie Window: You get credit for any purchase made within 60 days of the initial click.

US-Based Fulfillment: We currently ship exclusively within the United States, ensuring fast, reliable delivery for your referrals.

Support: Our team is dedicated to your success; we provide professional creative assets and early previews of new product launches.
payout_period: Enjoy reliable payouts via PayPal. Commissions are cleared for payment 30 days after the sale is finalized, ensuring a smooth and transparent process for every referral. Payout dates 1st or 16th. $50 minimum threshold.
